title: China’s CSI 300 Set to Lose Appeal Before Adding CXMT, BI Says
title_zh: BI称，沪深300指数在纳入长鑫存储之前将失去吸引力
summary: China’s CSI 300 Index risks losing its appeal as the nation’s key benchmark until it includes memory giant CXMT Corp., an event that’s unlikely to happen until the end of 2027, according to Bloomberg Intelligence.
summary_zh: 据 Bloomberg Intelligence 称，除非内存巨头长鑫存储纳入中国沪深 300 指数，否则中国的沪深 300 指数可能会失去作为中国主要基准的吸引力，而这一事件在 2027 年底之前不太可能发生。

title: S&P 500 notches record-high close as rate-hike worries ease
title_zh: 随着加息担忧缓解，标准普尔 500 指数收盘创历史新高
summary: VIDEO SHOWS: N/ASTORY: Wall Street's main indexes ended higher on Thursday, with the Dow ticking up marginally, the S&P 500 adding nearly two-thirds of a percent to close at a record high, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq climbing more than eight-tenths of a percent.Several chip stoc...
summary_zh: 视频显示：无故事：华尔街主要股指周四收高，道琼斯指数小幅上涨，标准普尔 500 指数上涨近三分之二，收于历史新高，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨逾十分之八。

title: Reddit Shares Surge on S&P 500 Inclusion Later This Month
title_zh: Reddit 股价本月晚些时候因纳入标普 500 指数而飙升
summary: Reddit Inc. will join the S&P 500 next week as part of an off-cycle change, S&P Dow Jones Indices said Thursday, sending the social networking platform’s shares surging more than 10% after the bell.
summary_zh: 标准普尔道琼斯指数周四表示，作为非周期变化的一部分，Reddit Inc.将于下周加入标准普尔 500 指数，这使得该社交网络平台的股价在盘后飙升超过 10%。

title: Trading Day: Hiking pressure eases
summary: By Jamie McGeever ORLANDO, Florida, Aug 13 (Reuters) - Stocks and bond prices rose on Thursday, with the S&P 500 barreling to a fresh high, as investors cheered another relatively benign snapshot of
summary_zh: 路透佛罗里达州奥兰多市 8 月 13 日 - 周四，股票和债券价格上涨，标准普尔 500 指数飙升至新高，投资者对另一次相对温和的前景感到欢呼。

title: Gemini & Zocdoc launch AI doctor booking
title_zh: Gemini 与 Zocdoc 推出人工智能预约医生
summary: Oliver Kharraz, Zocdoc Founder & CEO discusses teaming up with Google (GOOG) to integrate real-time healthcare appointment booking directly into the Gemini app, reducing patient wait times from 31 days to 72 hours while maintaining data privacy.
summary_zh: Zocdoc 创始人兼首席执行官 Oliver Kharraz 讨论了与 Google (GOOG) 合作，将实时医疗保健预约直接集成到 Gemini 应用程序中，将患者等待时间从 31 天减少到 72 小时，同时保持数据隐私。

title: Google becomes latest company to raise prices thanks to memory shortage
title_zh: 谷歌成为最新一家因内存短缺而提价的公司
summary: The AI-driven memory shortage strikes again.
summary_zh: 人工智能驱动的内存短缺再次来袭。

title: Nvidia bulls may have a small problem on their hands
title_zh: 看好英伟达的人可能遇到了一个小问题
summary: The market is positioned for the company to post great results and for CEO Jensen Huang to sound super bullish on the earnings call.
summary_zh: 市场预计该公司将公布出色的业绩，而首席执行官黄仁勋在财报电话会议上也将表现出超级乐观的态度。

title: Why this analyst sees another 30% rip in Microsoft stock
title_zh: 为什么这位分析师认为微软股票又下跌了 30%
summary: Microsoft shares could stay on fire.
summary_zh: 微软的股价可能会持续上涨。

title: We just had 'one of the most significant rotations of the current bull market': Strategist
title_zh: 我们刚刚经历了“当前牛市最重要的轮换之一”：策略师
summary: Truist chief investment officer and chief market strategist, Keith Lerner, explains why he thinks the bull market is still intact despite recent volatility.
summary_zh: Truist 首席投资官兼首席市场策略师基思·勒纳 (Keith Lerner) 解释了为什么他认为尽管最近出现了波动，但牛市仍然完好无损。
